prompt:
Use the supplied artist references for the SAME adult anime character Muse from the Meta AI fan design. Compact, rounded, layered shoulder-length ivory-white hair, messy bangs and one loose ahoge loop, with saturated cobalt blue inner layers and curled blue ends from mid-length down. Two pointed ivory furry alpaca ears on top, pink inner ear and small cream fur tuft in each; exactly two ears, no tail. Clear vivid blue eyes, thin dark rounded wire-frame glasses, ONE raised cobalt infinity-symbol hair clip at HER LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT in the front view). Plain cornflower blue ribbed sleeveless turtleneck crop top, with its high neck and ribbing as seen in reference. Open white cropped techwear jacket worn slipped just off the shoulders, short broad angular lapels with bright blue lining, oversized white sleeves, cobalt cuffs, narrow black/silver seam zips and a small number of cobalt straps, steel rectangular buckles and dark strap ends. White high-waisted sporty shorts with cobalt side panels, rounded leg hems and a black belt with a single rectangular brushed-metal buckle. One black band around HER LEFT thigh (viewer RIGHT in the front view), with one narrow hanging cobalt strap and dark metal end. White short gathered socks, bright cobalt perforated clogs with chunky scalloped ivory soles, ivory heel straps and little cream mascot-face/infinity-shaped clog charms as in the source. Color target for the saturated blue hardware and outerwear accents is #0866FF. Basic outfit matching the reference remains the same in all views.
Clean, careful 2D anime reference illustration in the same line-work, delicate pink-gray shading and white/blue palette as the reference. Opaque pure white background with no floor line, no gray cast shadow, no grid, no text, no border, no watermark. Draw exactly one centered requested asset, with open white margin on all four sides and no cropping of the requested silhouette. Preserve the design and proportions of the supplied art. Adapt only the requested pose or facial expression. No embellishments or added accessories.
Single orthographic full-height costume reference in neutral relaxed standing posture, feet level with each other, both arms gently separated from the jacket so seams and straps remain legible, fingers relaxed. Show everything from alpaca ear tips and ahoge loop to both complete clog soles in a vertical 3:5 frame. Both hands EMPTY; no smartphone, no Jolly, nothing perched on the shoulder and no action pose. No tail or extra ears. Keep the same midriff length, angular jacket design, thin glasses, only one thigh band on her left and blue-white shoes. Requested asset: strict front view with nose, sternum, belt buckle, knees and toes all facing straight toward the viewer. Eyes open, small relaxed closed-mouth smile, head level without tilt. Parallel feet shoulder-width or slightly narrower, no crossed legs. Hair clip and black thigh band must be on the viewer-right half of the image. The left/right arrangement of each reference is defined by the selfie image as seen by the viewer.
